title_en: Hollow Knight: Silksong Dev Gets Into the Direct Business With Cherry Time! Special Presentation
summary_en: Team Cherry has announced an upcoming Cherry Time! Special Presentation, during which it will issue an update on the hotly anticipated Hollow Knight: Silksong expansion, Sea of Sorrow.
body_en:
Team Cherry has announced an upcoming Cherry Time! Special Presentation, during which it will issue an update on the hotly anticipated Hollow Knight: Silksong expansion, Sea of Sorrow.
The Australian developer said this YouTube presentation will include “a bunch of excitements” in addition to the Sea of Sorrow update, sparking speculation that the developer may be ready to discuss what’s next. There is also speculation around what the Sea of Sorrow update will be. Could it be a shadow drop? A release date announcement for before the end of the year? Or, perhaps, word that Sea of Sorrow is somehow three times as big as expected so it's delayed and now a full-on sequel? Roll the dice!
Cherry Time! Special Presentation is set for 7am PT / 10am ET / 3pm UK time on Friday, November 27.
Team Cherry teased the nautically themed Sea of Sorrow in December last year with a 2026 release window. It's free for all players. As part of the DLC announcement, Team Cherry said Hollow Knight: Silksong had sold more than 7 million copies since going on sale in September 2025, and had millions more playing on Xbox Game Pass.
"It’s a truly staggering number of players, more than we could have ever expected (enough to crash all of the storefronts!)," Team Cherry said at the time. "Watching the community grow, seeing the amazing art, the mods, the unexpected strategies, and the support between players through the game’s challenges has been hugely rewarding for us here at home. Your continued enthusiasm remains a massive motivator as we work towards expanding the game even further."
IGN's Hollow Knight: Silksong review scored the game 9/10. We said: "Hollow Knight: Silksong is packed full of sharp platforming, enticing exploration, and nail-biting combat that's all unapologetically challenging in just the right way."
